articles.author: Bamboo Works
articles.headline: Citic Bank Gains A Backdoor Entry Into China’s Insular Tobacco Sector with Hongta Bank Stake
articles.summary:
The bank seized on a local government debt crunch to buy a stake in regional lender Hongta Bank, providing a conduit into China’s recession-proof cigarette monopoly







image credit: Bamboo Works



Key
articles._summary: The bank seized on a local government debt crunch to buy a stake in regional lender Hongta Bank, providing a conduit into China’s recession-proof cigarette monopoly There’s an old saying that where there’s smoke, there’s fire. In the case of China Citic Bank Corp. Ltd. (0998.HK; 601998.SH), where there’s smoke, there may also be a recession-proof, perpetually flowing wellspring of money. In a filing with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange last Friday, Citic Bank said it received the green light from the Yunnan bureau of the National Financial Regulatory Administration to acquire a 14.5% stake in regional lender Yunnan Hongta Bank . On the surface, this small investment looks like a drop in the bucket for a national giant like Citic Bank. The filing doesn’t include a transaction value, which indicates that it’s a small deal that doesn’t require more detailed disclosure. Media reports also confirm it’s a minor transaction — with a heavy discount.
articles._zh_headline: 中信银行借入红塔银行股份进入中国岛屿烟草行业
articles._zh_summary: 该银行抓住地方政府债务紧缩的契机，收购了地区银行红塔银行的股份，为中国抗衰退的卷烟垄断提供了渠道。有句老话说，哪里有烟，哪里就有火。以中信银行（0998.HK；601998.SH）为例，哪里有硝烟，哪里也可能有抗衰退、源源不断的资金源泉。中信银行上周五向香港联交所提交的文件称，已获得国家金融监督管理局云南局批准收购区域性银行云南红塔银行14.5%的股权。从表面上看，这笔小投资对于中信银行这样的全国性巨头来说只是杯水车薪。该文件不包括交易价值，这表明这是一笔小交易，不需要更详细的披露。媒体报道还证实，这是一笔小额交易，而且折扣很大。

articles.headline: Silver's Worst Month Since 2011: Why Wall Street's Favorite Trade Unraveled
articles.summary: Silver fell more than 20% in June 2026, its worst month since September 2011. Here's what drove the SLV selloff — and why some traders see an overreaction.
articles._summary: June is on track to be silver’s worst month in nearly 15 years. Momentum carried it to roughly $120 an ounce by late January. Five months later, that trade has crumbled. Here’s why. The first is silver’s tight relationship with gold. Bullion — tracked by the SPDR Gold Shares (NYSE: GLD ) — also fell hard in June, sliding more than 11% and giving back close to 30% from its own early-2026 peak. When the broader precious-metals complex turns, silver, the more volatile of the pair, tends to fall further and faster.

articles._zh_summary: 美国股指期货周三下跌，道琼斯指数、纳斯达克 100 指数和标准普尔 500 指数继周二收盘走高后下跌。与此同时，10年期国债收益率为4.47%，两年期国债收益率为4.17%。 CME 集团的 FedWatch 工具的预测显示，市场预计美联储在 7 月会议期间维持当前利率不变的可能性为 66.3%。
